title: NHS Expands 'Martha's Rule' to All Emergency Departments
subtitle: A vital safety system that allows patients and families to request an urgent second opinion is now reaching every A&E in England.

summary.en: The NHS is expanding a safety initiative called Martha's Rule to all emergency departments across England. This system allows patients, their families, and staff to request an urgent medical review if they feel a patient's condition is worsening. Named after 13-year-old Martha Mills, the rule aims to prevent medical tragedies by ensuring concerns are heard. The full rollout is expected to be finished by March 2028. Health officials believe this change will save lives and improve communication in hospitals.
summary.zh: 英國國民保健署正將名為「瑪莎條款」的安全倡議擴大至英格蘭所有急診室。此制度允許病患、家屬及員工在認為病患病情惡化時，要求進行緊急醫療審查。該條款以十三歲的瑪莎·米爾斯命名，旨在透過確保相關擔憂獲得傾聽，以防止醫療悲劇發生。預計於二零二八年三月完成全面推廣。衛生官員相信此變革將能挽救生命並改善醫院內的溝通。

paragraphs.en: The National Health Service (NHS) in England is taking a major step to improve patient safety by expanding 'Martha’s Rule' to every emergency department (A&E) in the country. This system gives patients, their families, and hospital staff the right to ask for a rapid, independent review of a patient’s care if they feel the person’s condition is getting worse and their concerns are not being addressed.
paragraphs.zh: 英國國民保健署 (NHS) 正採取重大舉措以提升病患安全，將「瑪莎條款」(Martha’s Rule) 推廣至全國所有的急診室。這項制度賦予病患、家屬及醫院員工一項權利，若他們認為病患病情惡化且擔憂未獲重視，即可要求針對病患的照護進行快速且獨立的審查。

paragraphs.en: This expansion is the latest phase of a national rollout that began after the tragic death of 13-year-old Martha Mills in 2021. Martha died from sepsis—a life-threatening reaction to an infection—after her parents’ repeated concerns about her deteriorating health were not acted upon quickly enough. A coroner later ruled that Martha would likely have survived if she had been moved to intensive care sooner. Her parents, Merope Mills and Paul Laity, campaigned for years to ensure that no other family would feel ignored in a similar situation.
paragraphs.zh: 此次擴大推廣是全國性計畫的最新階段，該計畫始於二零二一年十三歲少女瑪莎·米爾斯 (Martha Mills) 的悲劇性死亡。瑪莎因敗血症（一種對感染的致命性反應）過世，當時她的父母多次對她不斷惡化的健康狀況表達擔憂，卻未獲得足夠迅速的處置。驗屍官事後裁定，若瑪莎能更早轉入加護病房，極有可能存活。她的父母梅洛普·米爾斯 (Merope Mills) 與保羅·萊蒂 (Paul Laity) 多年來奔走倡議，確保不再有其他家庭在類似情況下感到被忽視。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, the initiative has already had a significant impact. In the first 16 months since the system was introduced in England in 2024, helplines received over 10,000 calls. These calls have potentially saved 446 lives by leading to necessary medication, urgent surgery, or transfers to intensive care units. Following successful trials on hospital wards and in maternity units, the NHS is now bringing this protective measure into the busy environment of emergency departments.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》(The Guardian) 報導，這項倡議已產生顯著影響。自二零二四年該制度在英國實施後的十六個月內，專線電話已接獲超過一萬通來電。這些通報透過促成必要的藥物治療、緊急手術或轉入加護病房，可能已挽救了四百四十六條生命。在醫院病房與產科單位試行成功後，國民保健署現正將這項保護措施引入繁忙的急診室環境中。

paragraphs.en: Professor Aidan Fowler, the national director of patient safety at NHS England, described the expansion as a "critical new lifeline." He noted that emergency departments see some of the most vulnerable patients, making the ability to trigger a fast review essential. "Martha’s rule is already having a transformative effect in making our acute care even safer," Professor Fowler told The Guardian. He added that the system allows staff to ask for a review from a different team if they believe the correct action is not being taken, providing support for both medical professionals and patients.
paragraphs.zh: 國民保健署英格蘭分署病患安全國家總監艾丹·福勒 (Aidan Fowler) 教授將此次擴大推廣形容為「關鍵的新生命線」。他指出，急診室收治的病患往往最為脆弱，因此啟動快速審查的能力至關重要。福勒教授向《衛報》表示：「瑪莎條款已在提升急性照護安全性方面發揮了變革性的作用。」他補充說，該制度允許員工在認為未採取正確處置時，要求由不同團隊進行審查，這為醫療專業人員與病患雙方都提供了支持。

paragraphs.en: During an eight-month pilot study at seven hospital trusts, 69 calls were made to the dedicated Martha’s Rule phone numbers. These calls helped doctors identify patients who needed immediate help, such as those who required urgent surgery or a move to intensive care. One success story shared by the BBC involves Chris Paterson, a 67-year-old man who was being treated for broken ribs. His son, Elliott, noticed his father’s health was failing due to a rare condition called Addison’s disease. By using the rule, the family was able to get the critical care team involved, which Elliott believes saved his father’s life.
paragraphs.zh: 在七家醫院信託機構進行的八個月試點研究期間，專屬的瑪莎條款電話號碼共接獲六十九通來電。這些來電協助醫師辨識出需要立即協助的病患，例如需要緊急手術或轉入加護病房的案例。BBC 報導分享了一個成功案例，六十七歲的克里斯·派特森 (Chris Paterson) 因肋骨骨折接受治療。他的兒子艾略特 (Elliott) 注意到父親因一種名為愛迪生氏症 (Addison’s disease) 的罕見疾病導致健康狀況下滑。透過使用該條款，家屬成功讓重症照護團隊介入，艾略特認為這挽救了他父親的生命。

paragraphs.en: While the expansion is a major development, the NHS has planned a phased approach to ensure it is implemented safely. Officials expect the full rollout across every A&E department in England to be finished by March 2028. This timeline allows hospitals to train staff and set up the necessary support systems to handle the requests effectively.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管此次擴大推廣是一項重大發展，國民保健署仍規劃了分階段執行，以確保安全落實。官員預計在二零二八年三月前，完成英格蘭所有急診室的全面推廣。此時程讓醫院有時間培訓員工並建立必要的支援系統，以有效處理相關請求。

paragraphs.en: The move has received strong support from health leaders. Matthew Hopkins, a director at the NHS Alliance, stated that health bosses welcome the rollout, as it empowers families to be active partners in their own care. Beyond England, the influence of Martha’s Rule is spreading. The BBC reports that Scotland has already begun using the system, while Northern Ireland is currently considering it. Wales also operates a similar scheme known as 'Call4Concern'.
paragraphs.zh: 此舉獲得醫療界領導人的強力支持。國民保健署聯盟 (NHS Alliance) 主管馬修·霍普金斯 (Matthew Hopkins) 表示，醫療主管們樂見此計畫推廣，因為它賦予家屬成為自身照護積極夥伴的能力。在英格蘭之外，瑪莎條款的影響力正持續擴散。BBC 報導指出，蘇格蘭已開始使用該制度，北愛爾蘭目前也正在研議中。威爾斯則運作著一項名為「呼籲關注」(Call4Concern) 的類似計畫。

paragraphs.en: For many, this initiative represents a change in the culture of hospitals. By giving families a formal way to speak up, the NHS hopes to bridge the gap between medical teams and those they treat. As the system reaches more emergency rooms, health officials hope to see a continued decrease in preventable deaths, ensuring that the concerns of patients and their loved ones are always taken seriously.
paragraphs.zh: 對許多人而言，這項倡議代表了醫院文化的轉變。透過提供家屬正式的發聲管道，國民保健署希望縮短醫療團隊與病患之間的距離。隨著該制度普及至更多急診室，衛生官員期望能持續減少可預防的死亡案例，確保病患及其摯愛的擔憂始終受到認真對待。

keyTerms.definitionEn: The official introduction or launch of a new product, system, or policy.
keyTerms.definitionZh: （新產品、系統或政策的）正式推出或啟用。
keyTerms.noteZh: 此詞常與動詞 roll out 連用，這裡作為名詞使用。文中：This expansion is the latest phase of a national rollout that began after the tragic death of 13-year-old Martha Mills in 2021.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To cause a process or action to begin.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（扳機），這裡作動詞用，指啟動某個程序。文中：He noted that emergency departments see some of the most vulnerable patients, making the ability to trigger a fast review essential.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To reduce the difference between two things or groups.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（橋樑），這裡作動詞用，指消除隔閡。文中：By giving families a formal way to speak up, the NHS hopes to bridge the gap between medical teams and those they treat.

quiz.question: What is the primary condition that must be met for a patient or family to trigger 'Martha’s Rule'?

options.A: The patient must be diagnosed with sepsis.
options.B: The patient's condition is deteriorating and their concerns are not being addressed.
options.C: The patient has been in the hospital for more than 16 months.
options.D: The hospital staff has officially requested a second opinion from a different team.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，該系統賦予病患及其家屬權利，在感覺病情惡化且擔憂未獲適當處理時，要求進行快速且獨立的護理審查。選項 A 錯誤，因為敗血症僅是 Martha 的案例，並非觸發規則的唯一條件。選項 C 錯誤，16 個月是該系統實施後的數據統計時間，非觸發條件。選項 D 錯誤，這項權利主要是賦予病患與家屬，而非僅限於醫護人員。

quiz.question: Based on the article, what can be inferred about the impact of 'Martha’s Rule' on hospital staff?

options.A: It creates more work and increases the pressure on emergency department doctors.
options.B: It replaces the need for intensive care units by providing home-based support.
options.C: It provides a mechanism for staff to seek support when they feel the current treatment plan is inadequate.
options.D: It forces doctors to follow the instructions of families even if they disagree with the medical protocol.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段 Professor Aidan Fowler 的說明，Martha’s Rule 不僅幫助病患，也讓醫護人員在認為目前的治療方案不當時，能要求不同團隊進行審查，這為醫護人員提供了額外的專業支持。選項 A 錯誤，文中強調的是提升安全性與支持，而非單純增加壓力。選項 B 錯誤，文中提到該規則是為了轉入加護病房，而非取代它。選項 D 錯誤，這是一個共同合作的機制，而非強制醫師無條件聽從家屬。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'lifeline' mean in the context of the NHS expansion?

options.A: A physical rope used for safety during hospital construction.
options.B: A source of help that is essential for survival in a difficult situation.
options.C: A new type of medical equipment used for monitoring heart rates.
options.D: A dedicated telephone line used exclusively by hospital directors.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此文中，'lifeline' 被用作比喻，指代一個能提供關鍵救助、對生存至關重要的機制。選項 A 是字面意義，在此語境下不適用。選項 C 錯誤，文中並未提到任何特定儀器。選項 D 雖然提到了電話，但 'lifeline' 在此處強調的是其救命的功能與價值，而不僅僅是一條電話線，因此 B 是最精確的語意解釋。

quiz.question: What is the main purpose of the article?

options.A: To explain the medical symptoms and causes of sepsis in teenagers.
options.B: To criticize the NHS for failing to protect patients in emergency departments.
options.C: To describe the history and future of medical training in England.
options.D: To introduce the expansion of 'Martha’s Rule' as a way to improve patient safety and communication.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。文章全文皆圍繞著 'Martha’s Rule' 的起源、實施成效、擴展計畫以及其對改善醫病溝通與病患安全的重要性。選項 A 僅是背景故事的一部分，非全文主旨。選項 B 錯誤，文章語氣偏向正面報導該政策的推動與成效，而非單純批判。選項 C 範圍過於廣泛，文中重點僅聚焦在該特定規則的推廣，而非整體醫學訓練。
